title: Shining Force III Premium Disc
native_title: シャイニング・フォースⅢ プレミアム・ディスク
overview: This is a bonus disc (only available in Japan) which was given free to customers having purchased all 3 scenarios. It contains lots of bonus music, films, artwork etc. which were used in the production of Shining Force III. It even has an extra battle mode, which lets you form a team of 12 from any of the characters from the Shining Force 3 scenarios and take them up against some challenging enemies - some of which may seem very familiar.
